title: A read of what an item's top comments say
description: What POST /api/v1/items/{key}/comments answers: how the read of the item's top comments stands. The first request queues one comments task, which a worker that reads the item's source and holds a model port runs as one model call. A later request queues none and answers the read as it stands, so a done answer is shown again with no second call. A failed read asks again only through `ingestion tasks retry`. The route refuses an item whose media type no source that the build carries reads comments of, with 422 comments_not_read. The answer is a model's over strangers' comments, so it ships as outsider text alone.
